title: It’s great AND it’s free!
body:
Wonderful little app. Does excactly what it says on the box! 
So if you’re into checking out your snoring/sleeping habits, and if you like not having to buy into a subscription based “app-experience”, and if you prefer that your private data stays local and doesn’t get shared with random companies and actually stay private? This is the app for you!

UX could be more intuitive - Especially in the Snoring Overview-section… 
But you’ll get the hang of it!

More specific filtering- and trimming-options would be appreciated as well.

But hey - Did I mention the app is FREE!! Who am I to complain.

Top app 👌

title: Une pépite
body:

Elle est ultra-performante: la détection est précise, et les enregistrements sont d’une clarté impressionnante. En plus, elle est gratuite, sans pub et économe en batterie, un vrai bonheur pour une utilisation longue sans se soucier de la recharge le lendemain.

L’interface est top tout est bien pensé, de la navigation fluide aux graphiques clairs pour analyser les résultats.

C’est rare de trouver une appli aussi complète, efficace et respectueuse de l’utilisateur.

title: App for data nerds and AI enthusiasts
body: The app provides great insights and trends about the sleep patterns and snoring, with additional integrations with Garmin and Apple watches, and also gives tips on how to improve your sleep. For those who want to take it up a notch, you can download the very rich data on every night that you can then overlap with sleep data from Garmin MCP through Claude to provide a really rich analysis of your sleep patterns and potentially find some areas you should pay closer attention to. I have improved my Garmin sleep score from 70-80 range to 85-98 range over the last two weeks and the low SpO2 episodes have dropped to close to zero.
